en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4. And it was narrated to me by Muhammad b. al-Hassan (rah) from Muhammad b. al-Hassan al-Saffar from al-Abbas b. Ma’ruf from Ali b. Mahziyar from Hamad b. Isa from Yahya b. Umar from Ishaq b. Ammar who said:
“If that is so, you should remain assured that you will get excessive wealth. Glad tiding to you for excessive wealth.”
